summary: Iteration 24 — backend + frontend testing of Pritha Cabinet CRM new features. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass (auth ACL, daybook read/write, cash verification upsert + ACL, daybook photos with APP_NAME prefix guard, /api/media/{token} PDF serving, admin PUT invoices/receipts + mixed payment validation, /api/receipts/source lookup, admin backup token/json/xlsx, daybook export-token/xlsx, /api/sales default scope=all + scope=mine, customer ledger totals + sale timeline receipts pdf_token). Frontend (390x844): admin daybook shows expected-cash-card, cash-calculator, den-input-500, calc-total updates to ₹1,000, calc-save produces recon-card, calc-clear present, daybook-photos + photo-capture visible, daybook-export in header, NO separate 'Cash count' button. emp2 correctly sees daybook-forbidden screen. Invoices card has inv-edit-<id> opening 'Edit INV-…' editor with inv-pay-cash/online/mixed + inv-save. Receipts card has rcpt-edit-<id> opening 'Edit RCPT-…' editor with rcpt-customer/amount/mode-*. Reports has backup-json (backup-xlsx testID present in code and visible in screenshot). CustomerPicker 'New customer' tab shows cust-dupe-box when typing existing name 'Poulomi' — with 'Already in the database — tap to use' banner. Customer ledger shows ledger-pdf-invoice-<id> and ledger-pdf-receipt-<id> buttons; PDF opens via /api/media/<token>. Cleaned up test data (cash_verification for today deleted, ZZTEST invoices/receipts/customers deleted).
action_items: No fixes required — all backend endpoints + frontend flows for iteration 24 features are working correctly.

NOTE: /app/backend/server.py is now 4188 lines (still growing; iteration 22 already flagged >700-line guideline). Consider modularizing (auth / customers / sales / invoices / receipts / daybook / admin) for maintainability. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 4188 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Non-blocking but overdue for a split.
DELETE /api/daybook/cash-verification is admin_only while the PUT is admin_or_collector. Confirmed matches spec ('emp1 -> 403 on delete'). Intentional but worth documenting in PRD.md.

Daybook photo prefix check hard-codes APP_NAME ('callflow-crm/'). If APP_NAME is ever changed via env, all historical photo/pdf paths + tokens will break. Consider storing/validating with an env-driven constant.
